programs.title: Deadliest Catch: Dead in the Water
programs.desc: Sean and Casey forge an alliance, but the first catch threatens the tenuous agreement  Wild Bill takes a big risk on a new idea hoping it will make up for a bumpy start  a dangerous mistake jeopardizes Jake's offload.

programs.title: Alaska: The Last Frontier: Homestead Overhaul
programs.desc: The Kilchers return, and with the family legacy in jeopardy, they start a complete homestead overhaul  the family must rescue a tractor before the ice road melts  a chimney fire could destroy Otto's cabin  Eivin and Eve burn up brush piles.

programs.title: Bering Sea Gold: Clash of the Titans
programs.desc: Shawn's crew forages ahead to reach the 1,000-ounce goal  the Kellys face blistering winds and monster currents as they move The Reaper into the sea.

programs.title: Breaking Point: Belgaum Commando School: Pushing the Limit
programs.desc: The commandos try to finish strenuous runs while carrying battle loads. Their bodies are pushed further as they complete difficult combat missions in a hostile jungle.
